name: Personalized Wooden 3D Cube Diorama With Acrylic Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and a clear acrylic box, offering a creative, durable, and eye-catching 3D display piece.
    - The inner diorama parts are made from 3mm thick wood, providing a sturdy structure while keeping the layered design lightweight and detailed.
    - The outer protective box is made from 3mm acrylic with no printing, helping protect the inner scene while keeping the display clear and elegant.
    - Designed with layered wooden components and custom standing pieces to create a vivid 3D miniature scene.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Finished acrylic box size:
             +) Width: 3.5 in ~ 8.89 cm
             +) Height: 3.24 in ~ 8.23 cm
             +) Top-down size: 3.5 in ~ 8.89 cm
    - Minimum size of custom shape wooden charm: 2 cm
    📌 Note: The size of the acrylic box is fixed and cannot be changed. The dimensions of the wooden charm may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for clear details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting personalization.
    - Acrylic Box: No printing
    - Supports double-sided printing on the entire wooden panel.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized 3D diorama display and a meaningful decorative keepsake.
    - Designed for desks, shelves, side tables, display cabinets, office tables, and memory corners.
    - The clear acrylic box helps protect the inner wooden scene from dust while maintaining full visibility.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, family keepsakes, graduation displays, wedding gifts, and commemorative gifts.
    - The layered wooden pieces create a miniature storytelling effect, making the product more interactive and visually special.
    - Perfect for displaying a personalized scene in a compact, elegant cube format.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, couples, parents, grandparents, teachers, graduates, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, graduations, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, holidays, and memorial keepsakes.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves customized décor, miniature display art, and sentimental keepsake gifts.
    - Great for home display, office display, shelf décor, and personalized memory collections.
    - A thoughtful gift that combines craftsmanship, storytelling, and personal emotion.
    - Adds a warm, unique, and memorable touch to any space

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
